Data.title: Employed Residents Aged 15 Years and Over by Planning Area of Workplace, Usual Mode of Transport to Work and Planning Region of Residence
Data.footnote: Notes: Planning areas refer to areas demarcated in the Urban Redevelopment Authority's Master Plan 2019.Data refers to the usual workplace location and not the temporary arrangements due to COVID-19 measures. Data exclude employed persons who were full-time students or overseas for at least 6 months. Full-time students are covered in the tables on usual transport to school.
